plumbing.review:
**[P2] Blank-named declarations receive duplicate identities.** At [components.go:272](components.go:272), only `init` receives an ordinal. Valid Go permits repeated `func _() {}` declarations and blank-named methods in one file. These produce identical component IDs, violating the promised identity for every declaration; selecting `_` then fails with “found 2.” Assign distinct stable identities and add regression coverage. The acceptance fixture covers repeated initializers but misses this case ([components_accept_test.go:166](components_accept_test.go:166)).

Otherwise, the change stays within scope and follows surrounding style. Acceptance sources match the ratified plan, with no weakened assertions or test special-casing found. The verification guard preserves legacy and model-only paths. I found no introduced network access, project-boundary escape, or secret disclosure. The merger’s decision-recording obligation remains explicitly documented.

This was read-only review; test success comes from the supplied factory report.

VERDICT: changes needed — disambiguate repeated blank-named declarations and add regression coverage.
